newsitem.title: USA: US layoffs down 28.5 pct Nov '96 vs Nov '95 - report.
newsitem.headline: US layoffs down 28.5 pct Nov '96 vs Nov '95 - report.

text.p: Announced U.S. job cuts fell 28.5 percent in November compared with the same month a year ago, said a report by Challenger, Gray & Christmas Inc.
According to the report 29,537 people lost their jobs in November, down from 41,293 in November 1995.
By comparison, 47,911 layoffs were announced in October.
Retailers, apparently optimistic about holiday season sales, laid off only 980 people last month, the lowest November total in three years, the report said.

"The business outlook, although not as optimistic as earlier in the year, at least for now is good enough to keep the job-cut rate low," said John Challenger, executive vice president of the outplacement firm.
The consumer goods sector reported 7,158 layoffs in November, topping the list, the report said. The financial services sector was second, with 4,362 announced cuts, it said.
